newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India's HPCL Vizag refinery not affected by storm.
newsitem.headline: India's HPCL Vizag refinery not affected by storm.

text.p: A cyclone which hit the low-lying coastland of southeast India late on Wednesday did not affect operations at Hindustan Petroleum Corp Ltd's (HPCL) Visakhapatnam refinery, a senior company official said on Friday.
"The cyclone didn't hit us...it was south of Vizag," he said.
HPCL operates a 90,000-barrel-per-day crude distillation unit in Visakhapatnam on the coast of the cyclone-hit state of Andhra Pradesh.
Latest reports by official said at least 510 people were killed during the storms which started on Wednesday.
